title: Manāpā amanāpā
text: 2 Pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato mātugāmo ekanta-amanāpo hoti purisassa || katamehi pañcahi || || Na ca rūpavā hoti || na ca bhogavā hoti || na ca sīlavā hoti || alaso ca hoti || pajañcassa na labhati || || Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato mātugamo ekantaamanāpo hoti purisassa || || 3 Pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato mātugāmo ekantamanāpo hoti-purisassa || katamehi pañcahi || || Rūpavā ca hoti || bhogavā ca hoti || sīlavā ca hoti || dakkho ca hoti analaso || pajañcassa labhati || || Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato mātugāmo ekantamanāpo hoti purisassa || ||
